question: In which scriptural contexts is this injunction said to apply especially?
premises: The injunction is related to all scriptures.
The Vaiṣṇava context is specifically mentioned.
It applies especially in that context.
inference: This applies in all scriptures, and especially in the Vaiṣṇava tradition.
plain_english: O goddess-lord, in all scriptures, and especially in the Vaiṣṇava tradition.
